## v0.1.10

- Add an admin-only SMTP test email action under Settings → Email notifications.
- Show the configured OIDC callback URL and clarify that allowed IDs are `sub` claim values, not scopes or email addresses.
- Log failed requests and relevant persistence, Emby, OIDC and transfer errors without exposing request query strings or media paths.
- Keep persistent settings and catalog data in `/data` and mount read-only SMB/NFS media separately at `/media`.
